# `/access-request-config` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /access-request-config/v1

`getAccessRequestConfigV1` — Get access request configuration — **DEPRECATED**

This endpoint returns the current access-request configuration. To manage approval configurations, use the [Put approval config](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/put-approvals-config-v-1/) endpoint.

- Scopes: idn:access-request-config:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, USER
- Returns 200: accessrequestconfig

### PUT /access-request-config/v1

`setAccessRequestConfigV1` — Update access request configuration — **DEPRECATED**

This endpoint replaces the current access-request configuration. To manage approval configurations, use the [Put approval config](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/put-approvals-config-v-1/) endpoint.

- Scopes: idn:access-request-config:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): accessrequestconfig
- Returns 200: accessrequestconfig

### GET /access-request-config/v2

`getAccessRequestConfigV2` — Get access request configuration — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint returns the current access-request configuration. To manage approval configurations, use the [Put approval config](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/put-approvals-config-v-1/) endpoint.

- Scopes: idn:access-request-config:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, USER
- Returns 200: accessrequestconfigv2

### PUT /access-request-config/v2

`setAccessRequestConfigV2` — Update access request configuration — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint replaces the current access-request configuration. To manage approval configurations, use the [Put approval config](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/put-approvals-config-v-1/) endpoint.

- Scopes: idn:access-request-config:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): accessrequestconfigv2
- Returns 200: accessrequestconfigv2
